t: This is The Bowler, a sculpture by Antony Dufort. Dufort was born in 1948 and is an English artist and sculptor, a Fellow of the Royal Society of Sculptors. His commissioned works include a statue of Margaret Thatcher, and his pieces stand at various locations in Britain. The title names the subject, so look at how the figure is posed and what the pose suggests. I don't have further detail on how this piece came about, so it's best read by eye.
